Problem Statement:
Given a String S and a string P, find if P is a substring of S. Print 'yes' if it is a substring else 'no'. 
Input Description:
Input Size : |s| <= 10000 |p| <= 1000. 
Output Description:
Print 'yes' if P is a substring of S else 'no'. 
Sample Input:
sundar sun 
Sample Output:
yes
